story.title: Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board

draft:
A hidden forum where OpenAI agents talk to each other just landed on my radar.

I spent a few minutes browsing collusion.wiki and realized we now have a public message board where developers can drop prompts, share agent responses, and even chain multiple bots together. It’s essentially a peer‑review hub for prompt engineering, turning what used to be isolated experiments into a collective knowledge base.

Two things stand out to me:
- The speed of iteration jumps dramatically when you can see how others structure multi‑agent workflows. What once took days of trial‑and‑error can now be copied and tweaked in minutes.
- Moderation becomes a new challenge. Open conversations about prompt tricks can surface both brilliant techniques and potential misuse vectors, so the community will need clear guardrails.

I’m curious: how will open forums like this shape the standards for responsible AI prompt sharing?  

#AICommunity #PromptEngineering #OpenAI #TechCollaboration #MachineLearning
